title: set and reopen write an item that check then fails: changed_items skips check's refused-command and docs-after-code errors
goal: changed_items, the write path of set, move and reopen, refuses every finding `check` counts as an error that the edit adds, refused_command_errors (a repro or check bl_intake.check_program_refusal or trivial_command refuses on an open item) and docs_after_code included, so set --check 'python3 -c pass' on an open item exits 2 with the item unchanged instead of writing an item that makes `backlog.py check` exit 1.

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();b=os.path.join(d,'kb','_self','backlog');os.makedirs(b);g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@example.com',*a],capture_output=True);g('init','-q');g('commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','a');it={'id':'BG-aaaaaaaa','kind':'bug','title':'T','status':'todo','priority':'P3','rank':0,'severity':'S3','goal':'g','repro':{'run':['python3','_tools/x.py']},'touches':['_tools/x.py']};open(os.path.join(b,'BG-aaaaaaaa.json'),'w').write(json.dumps(it));r=lambda *a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True);r('fmt');c0=r('check').returncode;s=r('set','BG-aaaaaaaa','--check','python3 -c pass');c=r('check');print('check before',c0,'set',s.returncode,s.stdout+s.stderr,'check after',c.returncode,c.stdout);sys.exit(1 if c0==0 and s.returncode==0 and c.returncode!=0 else 0)

gates.question: Once changed_items refuses refused-command errors, does reopen still let through the reopened item's own refused-command errors, which reopening only reveals?
